title: Help getting large sprite to fit

posts.author: Shatner_78
posts.body: I have this 128x128 moon sprite I want to use, but whenever I import it it's cut off in the tilemap editor. I'm new so I apologize if this is common knowledge or easier than I'm making it. Attached are images of what it is supposed to look like versus how it fits in the editor.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
Open RPG Maker and press F1.
Take a look on the Documentation > Assets Standards and also on Map > Map Properties (Especifically Parallax)
There you should learn how to proper format the assets and where is the best place to put your image(As a character, Picture, Parallax, Tileset etc...)

posts.author: pawsplay
posts.body: If it's a sprite, it can be any size as long as it's smaller than the screen. If you want to tile it, it needs to fit pretty strict standards.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body: I should add if you want it as a sprite it has to have 12 frames too (4 rows, 3 columns). So even if you want it to not animate you will need to put it in all 12 frames for it to work well.

posts.author: MiguelRPG
posts.body:
If you're not going to use it for mapping, it's best to use it as a parallax.
But if you're going to map it, create an image in a 768px x 768px editor and place this moon inside it, then it will look correct.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body: The A5slot is half-sized compared to the B-E slots. It would have been a better fit to place it in one of the B-E slots, although that would also have used up one of the two upper layers, making placing things on it more difficult.
